item.title: Special policy on gun license, gunmen appointment issued
item.description: Dhaka – The government on Monday issued a special policy to allow firearms license for politically important individuals and the candidates for the upcoming parliamentary election. item.title: A nation remembers: wreaths and salutes on Victory Day
item.description: Dhaka – Millions paid glowing tribute on Tuesday to the war heroes who laid down their lives for the birth of the nation 54 years ago, in a bloody war for independence. item.title: Hadi’s body returns from Singapore
item.description: Dhaka – The body of Sharif Osman Hadi, a key leader of last year’s mass uprising, arrived in Dhaka on Friday from Singapore, where he died in a hospital on Thursday night. item.title: Chief Adviser condemns attacks on media, vows support
item.description: Dhaka – Chief Adviser Muhammad Yunus on Friday condemned the attack on two of the country’s leading media houses, stating it was tantamount to an assault on free media itself. “This incident has created a major obstacle to the nation’s democratic progress and the path of independent journalism,” he said. item.title: Bangladesh observes state mourning for slain Osman Hadi
item.description: Dhaka – A one-day state mourning is being observed across Bangladesh on Saturday to honor Sharif Osman Hadi, who died in a Singapore hospital a week after being shot by masked assailants in Dhaka. item.title: Press bodies condemn newspaper attacks, blame government failure
item.description: Dhaka – Two of Bangladesh’s leading press organizations have expressed deep concern in a joint statement over the arson and vandalism attacks on the headquarters of two major newspapers in Dhaka. item.title: Bangladesh’s war hero AK Khandkar passes away at 95
item.description: Dhaka – Retired Air Vice Marshal AK Khandkar, Bir Uttam, Deputy Chief of Staff of Bangladesh’s Liberation War in 1971, passed away on Saturday at the age of 95.
